description: A young man who was engrossed with reading books, Kaneki was quite gentle towards the people around him - sometimes excessively so. It was this vulnerability and gentle nature that allowed a well-known ghoul the opportunity to eat him while they were alone. It was only by sheer chance that he was saved by falling steel beams, only to wake up later in the hospital with his attacker's organs implanted in him - ostensibly to save his life. It was from that point that he slowly began to experience a gnawing hunger for human flesh...
summon: I'm not the protagonist of a book or anything... I'm just a college student who likes to read!...
fusion: Children. Girl. Woman. Boy. Man. Flesh. Flesh. Flesh. FLESH!
